description: This file defines the omi::OmiProxy class, which implements the IOmiProxy interface for proxying operations related to crypted bundle management and listener registration within the omi namespace.

classes.name: omi::OmiProxy
classes.description: A proxy class implementing the IOmiProxy interface, providing methods for mount, unmount, and listener registration for crypted bundles.

methods.name: bool mountCryptedBundle(const std::string & id,const std::string & rootfs_file_path,const std::string & config_json_path,std::string & bundlePath)
methods.description: Mounts a crypted bundle given its identifier, filesystem path, JSON config path, and outputs the bundle path.

methods.name: bool umountCryptedBundle(const std::string & id)
methods.description: Unmounts a crypted bundle identified by its id.

methods.name: long unsigned registerListener(const OmiErrorListener & listener,const void * cbParams)
methods.description: Registers a listener for omi events, returning a tag identifier.

methods.name: void unregisterListener(long unsigned tag)
methods.description: Unregisters a previously registered listener with the given tag.

ctags.signature: (const std::string & id,const std::string & rootfs_file_path,const std::string & config_json_path,std::string & bundlePath)
